## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does this work with my [framework/CMS]?

Yes. It's a single <script> tag. If your site can load JavaScript, it works. We've tested on Webflow, WordPress, Shopify, custom HTML, React, Next.js, Vue—everything.

### How does it “know” my site content?

When you create a bot we crawl your whole site (not just one page) and you can upload documents (PDFs, text files) with extra knowledge. In chat, the bot uses that training data plus the page the visitor is currently viewing.

### Will it recommend my competitors?

Never. We built explicit rules: if the bot can't find information on YOUR site, it connects the visitor to your team. It will not suggest other companies.

### What AI model powers this?

OpenAI's GPT-4o-mini. It's fast, accurate, and answers from your crawled pages and uploads.

### Can I customize the bot's personality?

Yes (Pro plan and up). Set the bot's name, description, and additional context. It'll maintain the natural, site-aware behavior while matching your brand voice.

### What if a visitor asks something off-topic?

The bot politely redirects: “I'm here to help with questions about our company. What would you like to know about our services?”

### How accurate is it?

Very. It reads the literal text on your page, so if the information is there, it'll find it. We automatically limit responses to YOUR domain only.

### Can I see chat history and analytics?

Yes! All plans include chat history. Pro and Business plans get full analytics dashboards showing conversation volume, common questions, topics visitors care about, and insights to help you improve your content and understand customer needs.
